node.statement: The cited compressed-corner estimate supplies universal constants C_corner < infinity and e_corner > 0 such that in every epsilon-C*-algebra, for delta-projections U,V,W and e=delta+epsilon <= e_corner, all X in S_{U,V} and Y in S_{V,W} satisfy ||Co_{U,W}(XY)-XY|| <= C_corner*e*||X||||Y||.
